title: Fire of Moscow (1571)
text: The Fire of Moscow occurred on 24 May 1571, when a Crimean army led by the khan of Crimea Devlet I Giray together with its allied tribal contingents bypassed the Serpukhov defensive fortifications on the Oka River, crossed the Ugra River into the Moscow suburbs, and rounded the flank of the 36,000–40,000 men of the Russian army.
